author: Gummy258
body: My minecraft username is GoldenCreeper258, and i was banned for advertising because i didn't know that that was bannable and wasn't allowed. I am very sorry and I didn't know where I could find the rules. I promise that if you unban me, there would be no reason to ban me again. I'm sorry. One of the only reasons that I am appealing a ban is because this is one of the only servers that I play and like.
